about_the_game:
Learn to read, recognize, and use hiragana as you are guided by Keen Reflex through a 35-floor ever-changing labyrinth in an addictive and educational dungeon crawler RPG!

Learning to read hiragana is the first step in your Japanese learning journey, and it's the first hurdle that learners struggle to get over.

This addictive RPG dungeon crawler will have you reading Japanese in record time without all that boring study.

After deciding to learn Japanese, you're introduced to Keen Reflex, an online streamer who teaches viewers Japanese with his experience as a professional Japanese translator and with his JLPT N1 Japanese fluency. When you go to watch his stream, though, you are mysteriously teleported INSIDE the Japanese learning game Keen is playing. You find yourself in a magical land filled with creatures called hiragana that can only be defeated by shouting their name. The only way out seems to be to make your way through puzzles and hoards of hiragana, leveling up your stats and your reading comprehension along the way!
